turns.content: The interaction contains a term proportional to X times a fermion bilinear. For a 6-GeV boson X, what is the lowest-order decay topology into the charged fermion flavours u, d, s, c, b, t, e, mu, and tau?
Derive the relativistic threshold condition for a two-body fermion-antifermion final state of equal masses.
Apply that threshold to the charged leptons and determine which pair channels are open.
Apply the same threshold to the quarks and separate the open channels from the forbidden ones.
Combine the lepton and quark results into the complete lowest-order channel set.
Check each excluded heavy flavour against the threshold and verify that every retained channel satisfies it.
Report the allowed decays together with the mass-threshold condition.
